about_the_game:
You will never escape Yet Another Killing Game with this full original soundtrack collection! Vibe to lo-fi beats, fondly recall Cecilia and Oriana, and relive the killing game wherever you go with these 26 tracks composed by Kerry Cobuccio, Kei2 Lee, and Jonathan Shim!

All proceeds from this soundtrack go to the composers! Please show them your support!

WORDS FROM OUR COMPOSERS

"Thank you so much for listening to my music! I have always wanted to write music for a horror game, and I’m so grateful for the opportunity! I especially enjoyed writing the theme for Cecilia; it’s fun to work with a character who is so crazy! 😄

I hope you enjoy listening to the music as much as I enjoyed writing it and hopefully I can write music for a horror game again!" 

— Kerry Cobuccio

 

"Thank you so much for listening.

Working on this project has been a great experience and I had the pleasure of working with an amazing team. It was fun to compose different genres of music to create the right vibe for each scene. Hope you will enjoy what we have created.

Thank you for supporting Yet Another Killing Game!"

— Kei2 Lee

 

"Thank you for enjoying the soundtrack to Yet Another Killing Game!

As the first major game I have worked on, working on this soundtrack was full of joys, challenges, and lots of learning. I had the pleasure of writing most of the music for Oriana, who in many ways is much like myself - I hope that you can see me in the music I made.

Music and games have been with me my whole life, and I'm excited to be able to share this with you all.

Thank you for listening and for supporting us in making this Killing Game possible!"

— Jonathan Shim
